title: Dogs

source.name: Simple English Wikipedia — Dog
source.note: Chuyển thể sang mức A1 (câu ngắn, từ đơn giản); thông tin theo bài gốc.

paras: Dogs are animals. They are mammals. Many people keep dogs as pets. Some dogs work on farms. Some dogs work for the police. Some dogs help people in the mountains.

Dogs come from wolves. They were the first animals to live with people. Dogs are popular pets because they are friendly and they listen to people. Dogs eat meat and vegetables. People say a dog is a human's best friend.
